cmd:
cat > /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh << 'WRAPPER_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# run_timed.sh <label> <logfile> <command...>
LABEL="$1"; LOGFILE="$2"; shift 2
S=$(date +%s)
"$@" >> "$LOGFILE" 2>&1
E=$(date +%s)
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] $LABEL duration: $((E-S))s" >> /var/log/vps-durations.log
WRAPPER_EOF
chmod +x /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh
cat /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh

crontab -l | grep -v "vps_pipeline.py\|vps_satellite_pipeline.py\|run_timed.sh" > /tmp/cron_new2.txt
echo "*/5 * * * * /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh main /var/log/vps-pipeline.log /usr/bin/python3 /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/vps_pipeline.py" >> /tmp/cron_new2.txt
echo "2,7,12,17,22,27,32,37,42,47,52,57 * * * * /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh satellite /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log /usr/bin/python3 /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/vps_satellite_pipeline.py" >> /tmp/cron_new2.txt
crontab /tmp/cron_new2.txt
echo '--- crontab now ---'
crontab -l
echo '--- manual sanity test ---'
/opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh test /tmp/test_timed.log sleep 3
cat /var/log/vps-durations.log
